recommendations.root_cause_hypothesis: High shopper engagement (48 physical inspections) in 'Aisle 3 - Canned Goods, Soups & Condiments' has an abnormal Friction Index of 91.7% (Conversion: 8.3%). This discrepancy typically indicates an on-shelf price discrepancy vs POS, missing price tags, damaged packaging, or uncompetitive pricing relative to adjacent items.
operational_actions: Dispatch floor associate to Aisle 3 - Canned Goods, Soups & Condiments to audit shelf pricing tags against POS master pricing.
Inspect physical stock for damaged boxes, broken seals, or nearing expiration dates.
Evaluate competitor pricing on top SKU 'General Grocery' or introduce an on-shelf promotional discount tag.
Ensure clear nutritional, sizing, or compatibility labels are visibly displayed.
recommendations.estimated_impact: Recovers estimated +15% to +25% in lost sales (approx. $576/week potential uplift).

recommendations.zone_name: Aisle 8 - Baby Care & Pet Food Supplies
recommendations.root_cause_hypothesis: Foot traffic in 'Aisle 8 - Baby Care & Pet Food Supplies' (28 shoppers) is only 14.1% of the supermarket average (198 shoppers/zone). This chronic traffic void indicates poor aisle line-of-sight, obstructive promotional standees blocking the corridor, sub-optimal category placement, or inadequate overhead illumination.
operational_actions: Remove bulky freestanding floor displays or pallet drops blocking the entrance to Aisle 8 - Baby Care & Pet Food Supplies.
Relocate high-demand staple categories (e.g. coffee, cooking oil, popular snacks) into Aisle 8 - Baby Care & Pet Food Supplies to generate pull-through traffic.
Install high-visibility overhead aisle navigation markers pointing toward Aisle 8 - Baby Care & Pet Food Supplies.
Introduce an eye-level 'Weekly Manager's Special' endcap at the approach to Aisle 8 - Baby Care & Pet Food Supplies.
recommendations.estimated_impact: Balances store floor circulation; expected +30% to +50% foot traffic normalization.

recommendations.root_cause_hypothesis: Severe checkout bottleneck detected at Checkout 03 04. Current queue length is 6 customers with an average wait time of 5.6 minutes (P90: 6.7 min). Current checkout throughput (mu = 0.6 cust/min) is overwhelmed by queue surge.
operational_actions: Immediately open standby checkout register(s) (Express Lane 4 & 5).
Deploy front-end floor associate to assist with bag packing and scan queue line-busting.
Direct eligible basket shoppers (< 10 items) to self-service checkout terminals.
Verify barcode scanner and EFT-POS payment terminal latency on Checkout 03 04.
recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduces customer wait time by ~60% (from 5.6 min to < 2.0 min) and prevents checkout cart abandonment.

recommendations.root_cause_hypothesis: Suspected on-shelf stockout or empty facade at Shelf 'shelf_organic_berries' in Fresh Organic Produce (Organic Hass Avocado). AI vision detected 18 customer reach interactions, with 15 instant put-backs (83%) and 0 POS sales. Customers are reaching into the display shelf, finding the specific variant/size missing, and immediately withdrawing.
operational_actions: Trigger emergency stock replenishment task for 'Organic Hass Avocado' from backroom inventory.
Pull forward remaining stock from the back of shelf shelf_organic_berries to ensure full facade visibility.
Verify inventory count in ERP system to reconcile phantom inventory discrepancies.
Place temporary out-of-stock tag with restock ETA or suggest adjacent substitute product.
recommendations.estimated_impact: Recovers an estimated $300 to $800/day in preventable lost stockout revenue.
